experiment: prune-and-graft test (standalone, not an engine integration)

settings.classes_rule: be._base_classes(layout, 0): all genes CLS_OLD except couple 0 head CLS_DECODER; no CLS_DRAW genes (engine founder-continuation rebase; see script docstring)

donors.note: the vault stage champion is the subject itself, and the subject's own checkpoint best row is the same genome; both are inventoried but excluded from grafting (a donor identical to the subject could only re-fill slots with the subject's own genes, and at pruned slots its own drops are <= 0 by construction).
